results.title: ‘Very, very scary’: Fires at San Francisco’s oldest park have neighbors on edge - San Francisco Chronicle
results.content: # ‘Very, very scary’: Fires at San Francisco’s oldest park have neighbors on edge. The blaze that night was one of several fires in San Francisco’s oldest park over the past year. The San Francisco Fire Department has responded to 23 outdoor fires along Buena Vista Avenue, which surrounds most of the park, in the year leading up to Sept. The data does not indicate whether the other 18 were in the park, but the avenue runs between the park on one side and homes and apartments on the other, so it seems likely that some or many of the additional outdoor fires were linked to the park. Mariano Elias, a spokesperson for the fire department, would not comment on the specific causes of fires at the park, but said there are “many homeless encampment fires in areas across town,” and those numbers have increased in recent years.

Burton didn’t have a health issue. [...] Salaun received a rousing ovation when she entered the game with 2:25 left in the first quarter after being named WNBA Sixth Player of the Year before the game.
